title: Dog with valid pass, not in carrier

turns.user: I have a valid Budapest pass and want to bring one dog on a tram within Budapest. Does it need its own ticket?
turns.agent: No separate dog ticket is needed for one dog on a tram within Budapest, provided your Budapest pass is valid. If the dog is not in a suitable fully closed carrier, keep it leashed and muzzled; carry valid animal vaccination documentation. This is based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live policy check. See BKK’s Dogs on public transport guidance for current conditions.

turns.user: The dog won't be in a carrier. What safety rules should I follow?
turns.agent: For a dog travelling outside a carrier, keep it on a leash and muzzled. Also carry its valid vaccination documentation. The 5 November 2026 snapshot supports these conditions for your stated case (one dog on a tram within Budapest with a valid pass); it is not a live policy check. See BKK’s Dogs on public transport page for current rules.
